claims.claim: A source-grounded pipeline improves independently adjudicated source-facet fidelity on unseen natural source-family/time groups.
claims.narrowing_rule: Without independent labels and measured controls, retain only method description; teacher loss cannot support this claim.

claims.claim: Checked bridges and bounded learned advice improve useful native-checker proof coverage without increased false transfer.
claims.narrowing_rule: Solver-local or fixture outcomes cannot establish native proof coverage; unavailable proof routes remove this claim only.

claims.claim: Shared learning generalizes beyond sample memory.
claims.narrowing_rule: T1 is a memorization diagnostic; no final-test/trained-checkpoint evidence means no gain claim.

claims.claim: Isolated trusted proof feedback improves routing/calibration without harming source fidelity.
claims.narrowing_rule: A predictive head or checker-derived target without isolated update/checker evidence does not support this claim.

claims.claim: Promoted guidance improves a real compiler/realizer consumer on unseen material.
claims.narrowing_rule: An export or canary-only result without load receipt and locked-test evaluation does not support deployment improvement.

claims.claim: A bounded executable repair improves a sealed starting arm without test-selected patches.
claims.narrowing_rule: A proposed or unexecuted patch is methods evidence only and does not complete T5.

claims.claim: Retrieval, premise selection, planning, and proof assistance have separable matched-budget utility.
claims.narrowing_rule: Proxy labels, hand-authored selector weights, or declared-only routes stay qualified and cannot support utility claims.

global_guardrails: No value, zero, capability, activation, or completion follows from code, fixtures, plan entries, or unavailable conditions.
Final-test outcomes cannot select settings, prompts, grammar, thresholds, retrieval tuning, or patches.
Narrowing a claim never changes a run status or completes the empirical goal.
